rust_summary: sounds and particles in a level through a `LevelRef`, sent to every player in range.
doc_summary: `level.play_sound(host, sound, at, source, volume, pitch)` and `level.send_particles(host, options, state, at, spread, speed, count)`: every player in range hears or sees them, as `ServerLevel.playSound` and `sendParticles` send them. Bundles need "hooks": @API:level_effects@.
